correctness.rationale: Normalize Haar-uniform S³ objective by independent Gaussian plane blocks; squared first-plane radius is Beta(1,1)=Unif[0,1], nearest-vertex angles independent Unif[0,π/p] and Unif[0,π/q]. Conditional first-group win probability is cos²u/(cos²u+cos²v), giving exact 2D integral F and 1D arctan reduction. Monotonic coupling gives F<1/2 if p<q. For p≥4 auxiliary G(u) increasing on (0,π/4] yields F>F∞>p/(2p+1)≥p/(p+q); for p=3 Cauchy–Schwarz and rational bounds handle q=4 and all q≥5. Thus strict total/per-vertex inversion for every integer pair. Independent one- and two-dimensional quadratures agree for five pairs, including p=4,q=5; not proof of universal inequality.
